story.titleZh: 梅赛德斯提醒：雪邦赛道时隔多年重新铺装，注意轮胎衰竭
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队在X上发帖称，雪邦赛道自上次重新铺装以来已过去多年，需警惕可能出现的较高轮胎衰竭，并邀请车迷前往官网查看巴林大奖赛轮胎话题。

story.summaryEn:
It's been a few years since Sepang's last resurface- so look out for potential high tyre degradation! 🛞
Catch up with tyre talk for the Bahrain GP in Malaysia on our website 👇https://bit.ly/TyreTalkBahrainGPinMalaysiaTW
